article.title: The long march at ninety: Sovereignty and dual power: The Twentieth Asia Newsletter (2026)
article.author: Editor
article.content: Years before victory in 1949, Chinese communists built a state from below in the mountains of Ruijin–with its own bank, currency, schools, and recallable officials–offering lessons the Global South still needs today.
